# Real document regression fixtures

These unmodified files come from the LibreOffice test suite (MPL 2.0; see [COPYING.MPL](./COPYING.MPL)). They are actual document files, distinct from the authored synthetic fixtures in the test generator.

* `cdr15.cdr`: `writerperfect/qa/unit/data/draw/libcdr/pass/fdo65220-2.cdr`; the RIFF signature identifies CorelDRAW generation 15 (X5). Source: https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/master/writerperfect/qa/unit/data/draw/libcdr/pass/fdo65220-2.cdr
* `libreoffice.eps`: `vcl/qa/cppunit/graphicfilter/data/eps/pass/fdo13433-4.eps`. Source: https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/master/vcl/qa/cppunit/graphicfilter/data/eps/pass/fdo13433-4.eps

Passing these regressions does not certify all files of either format, all CDR versions, or visual fidelity to Illustrator/CorelDRAW.
